name: gate-g8
note: A gate row of renderer/shell/gate_d02.py: the steps before the repeat block set the views; the block runs for warm-up plus window seconds as quiet steps (d02_run.expand_repeat), and tools/perf/d02/gate_row.py times the last window seconds. No step follows the block, so the window holds only the row's views. B24 G8: the simulation matrix held (tuning.simulate.hold deutan, B14's view style) on G9's two views and sweeps; it is not released before the quit. Cap 2 is named because its twelve menu items are admissible at deep-2 and wj-ia-end (the samples' cap-2 release checks); K, the router's item 2, commits and sweeps over jumble.sweep's time, and repeats cycle through the twist's powers. A refused press sweeps nothing, which gate_d02 reports as an invalid run. The sweeps turn the grip's cap: grip.select names cap 2 (its frame 0) before the repeat block, so the router's twist keys turn cap 2, not the default grip cap 0 (blocked at deep-2, wj-ia-end and wj-ia-300); gate_d02.py moves the selection and the naming to an admissible cap of a run's state from its sample rim.json when cap 2 is not one.
